company.shortDescription: SunFarmer provides solar energy for hospitals, schools, businesses, and farms in developing countries.
company.description: SunFarmer is a nonprofit organization that provides the capital and technical expertise needed to bring solar energy to hospitals, schools, and other institutions that lack reliable energy.
